items.quote: Absolutely loved my Dominican cake, it was delicious. Kasandra was very kind and extremely helpful by explaining the different options and decorations available. She did an amazing job decorating the cake and nailed my inspo picture.
Me and my family love this bakery. I love that she offers slices of cakes and small cakes daily. Freshness is guaranteed. Communication is great. Pick up process is easy.

Almost every single order I've placed with her has literally been the same day, and somehow she always comes through for me without hesitation. Everything is always fresh, delicious, beautifully made.
